title: Ripple launch set
description: The real weekly data that arrives after a launch. Written by model/ripple_model/synth.py to web/public/model/launches.json; read by the /launch page and by the agent tool update_with_launch(). Three demo launches ship with known truth.

type.description: Which unknown is being learned: a city effect, an offer's lift/elasticity, or a never-seen feature.

description.description: One sentence shown under the launch picker.

unknown.description: The single quantity the update learns. Its prior comes from the fitted model, except for a new feature, where it is deliberately skeptical.

label.description: Readable, e.g. 'Austin city effect' or 'Lift from gift boxes'.

kind.description: Tells the update engine how the unknown enters log mu.

segment.description: Set when the unknown is per segment (b_promo, elasticity).

dist.description: 'normal' = parametric prior drawn fresh (z_new_city, theta); 'posterior' = reuse the fitted draws.

sigma.description: For a new feature this is the skeptical scale, default 0.15; the UI lets the user change it.

editable_sigma.description: True when the UI should expose a prior-scale slider.

display.description: How to format the unknown's posterior in the UI.

weeks_observed.description: How many weeks of real data exist — the max of the week slider.

t0.description: Absolute week index of launch week 1, so season(t) lines up with the fitted model.

cities.description: Cities touched by the launch. For new_city, the one new name.

observations.description: Observed launch weeks, columnar. One row per week x city x segment (x holdout arm when present). All arrays share one length.

city_idx.description: Index into posterior.meta.cities, or -1 for the new city.

treated.description: 1 = the unknown applies to this cell; 0 = control. Always 1 unless there is a holdout.

holdout.description: Present only when the data has a randomized control arm; then the result is labelled 'experiment'.

has_holdout.description: True ⇒ a random control group exists ⇒ label the lift 'experiment', not 'model-based estimate'.

fixed_cost.description: Launch or campaign cost over the horizon.

net_price.description: Price charged during the launch, for the revenue and profit lines.

truth.description: Demo launches only — the planted answer, revealed by the 'Show truth' toggle. Absent for uploaded launch data.

unknown_value.description: True value of the unknown, in the same units as its posterior.

unknown_percent.description: Same thing as a percent lift, when display is percent_lift.

total_units.description: True total units over the full horizon.

causal_assumptions.description: The 3 conditions under which the lift is causal, shown as a checklist.

holds.description: null = the user has to judge it.
